description.narrative: Sida provided support to the Regional Project with an overall objective to enhance the credibility, transparency, effectiveness and sustainability of electoral institutions and procsses in the region. The objectives of the intervention were implemented under three key output results during the period from December 2013 to February 2017 1. Strengthened Regional Capacity and Knowledge on Electoral Issues. 2. Increased Participation of Women Throughout the Elctoral Cycle. 3. Formal and Informal Mechanisms in place to enable Youth Civil Society Organizations and Youth Civic Engagement in Govermnent Led and Other Political Processes.

The project achieved strengthened regional cooperation and networking which has been reflected in establishment of a formation of an Arab Association of Electoral Management Bodies (ArabEMBs), formal and strenghtened capacity of the Leage of Arab States on electoral issues, complimenting their enhanced capacity by increased Building Resources for Democracy, Governance and Elections (BRIDGE) trainings. The project generated knowledge and capacity enhancement of electoral stakeholders such as a Regional Lexicon, BRIDGE trainings, various knowledge products as a result of the global focus on the Arab Region in this field (EC-UNDP Joint Task Force). Increased participation of youth and women through youth forums, BRIDGE trainings for Gender and Electionsm and regional participations.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
